channel.title: Inflight Digest
channel.description: Independent trade news on airline catering, inflight entertainment, cabin interiors and onboard service.

item.title: China Eastern Brings Fresh Starbucks Coffee to First and Business Class
item.description: China Eastern Airlines has begun serving freshly prepared Starbucks Arabica coffee in first and business class, bringing café-style coffee to its premium cabins as part of a broader "aviation plus coffee" partnership with Starbucks and Nestlé.

item.title: United Airlines Replaces 250 Million Plastic Cups With New Universal Paper Design
item.description: August 1, 2026 — United Airlines has begun replacing its signature transparent blue plastic cups with a new recyclable paper “universal cup” as part of its efforts to reduce single-use plastics across its onboard operations.

item.title: Putin Authorizes Aeroflot to Acquire Lufthansa-Linked 49% Stake in Aeromar
item.description: On March 16, 2026, Russian President Vladimir Putin authorized Aeroflot to acquire the remaining 49% stake in Aeromar held by Truffle 2 GmbH, a Lufthansa-linked company, paving the way for Aeroflot to become the sole owner of Russia’s largest inflight catering company.

item.title: Shenzhen airport gets Cartier's relocated boutique
item.description: Cartier has reopened its boutique at Shenzhen Bao'an in the domestic departures hall of Terminal 3, operated with China Duty Free Group. The redesigned spacecarries a champagne-gold façade with undulating patterns drawn from the city'scoastline

item.title: Starlink Wi-Fi goes live on Lufthansa
item.description: Lufthansa Group will equip around 850 aircraft with SpaceX's Starlink high-speed internet, with the rollout planned across the group's airlines by 2029. The inaugural flight took place on 19 August 2026, from Frankfurt to Rome.

item.title: KitKat Japan flavours arrive at Qatar Duty Free
item.description: Qatar Duty Free and Nestlé International Travel Retail have opened a three-month KitKat "Taste of Japan" pop-up at Hamad International, running across the South Node, North Node and Central concourses since 10 August.

item.title: KLM launches ‘Grand Café KLM’ with more choice on European flights
item.description: Starting in October, KLM will introduce Grand Café KLM, a new onboard service concept on European flights offering passengers more choice and flexibility.

item.title: China’s leading producer of frozen aviation meals: Nanjing Weizhou Airline Food
item.description: SATS (Singapore) has taken control of Nanjing Weizhou Airline Food Corp., Ltd (NWA), increasing its stake in the Chinese aviation meal producer to 90%. The company, based in Nanjing, is one of China’s leading producers of frozen aviation meals, supplying airlines with frozen meals, snacks and food components.
